root_causes: The existing approved-central-blog workflow created open PRs without delivery-hygiene machine metadata or source-bound Brain/ledger/human closure, so every valid queue item failed protected CI.

A 2026-09-17 typo-duplicate source stayed 'Pending' with an obsolete approval even though the canonical article had already been consolidated with a permanent redirect. Its unchanged writer recreated the same duplicate PR at least eleven times.
prevention: Keep the original publisher sole writer; auto-materialize exact queue/source/approval identity, immutable Base-SHA and seven scoped candidate files at PR creation, including truthful CANDIDATE_NOT_LIVE closure artifacts.
Reject source slug when permanent 301 redirect already maps it to another canonical blog, and skip old pages already in main; do not republish or weaken protected SEO tests.
Publication counts only after Required, CodeQL, BG169, Netlify public URL/SHA readback and ONE BRAIN/Heartbeat. Existing user review and media boundaries remain enforced.
